messages.subject: Shiny tic-tac-toe
parts:
I have done this to try the clickId option of plotOutput().

library(shiny)

morpion0 <- function(){
  plot(0, 0, xlim=c(1,4), ylim=c(1,4), type="n", axes=FALSE, xlab=NA, ylab=NA)
  abline(v=1:4)
  abline(h=1:4)
  invisible()
}

get_center <- function(x,y){
  c(x0=floor(x)+.5, y0=floor(y)+.5)
}
get_coef <- function(x,y){
  c(i=4-floor(x), j=floor(y))
}

runApp(
  list(
    server=function(input, output, session){
      clicks <- reactiveValues(
        x0=NULL, # x-coordinate of the center of the box 
        y0=NULL, # y-coordinate of the center of the box 
        A=matrix(0, nrow=3, ncol=3), # player A
        B=matrix(0, nrow=3, ncol=3) # player B
      )
      update <- reactive({
        if(is.null(input$click)) return(NULL)
        x <- input$click$x
        y <- input$click$y
        coef <- get_coef(x,y)
        i <- coef["i"]
        j <- coef["j"]
        current <- list(x0=isolate(clicks$x0),y0=isolate(clicks$y0),A=isolate(clicks$A),B=isolate(clicks$B))
        n <- length(current$x0)
        if(current$A[i,j]==0 && current$B[i,j]==0){
          center <- get_center(x,y)
          x0 <- center["x0"]
          y0 <- center["y0"]
          x0 <- current$x0 <- c(current$x0, x0)
          isolate(clicks$x0 <- x0)
          y0 <- current$y0 <- c(current$y0, y0)
          isolate(clicks$y0 <- y0)
          current$A[i,j] <- 1
          isolate(clicks$A <- current$A)
          points(x0, y0, pch=rep_len(c("x","o"), length(x0)), cex=7, col=rep_len(c(2,3), length(x0)))
          free <- which(current$A==0 & current$B==0)
          if(length(free)!=0){
            b <- sample(free, 1)
            current$B[b] <- NA
            coef <- which(is.na(current$B), arr=TRUE)
            center <- get_coef(coef[1], coef[2])
            x0 <- center["i"]+.5
            y0 <- center["j"]+.5
            x0 <- c(current$x0, x0)
            isolate(clicks$x0 <- x0)
            y0 <- c(current$y0, y0)
            isolate(clicks$y0 <- y0)
            points(x0, y0, pch=rep_len(c("x","o"), length(x0)), cex=7, col=rep_len(c(2,3), length(x0)))
            isolate(clicks$B[b] <- 1)
          }
          invisible()
        }
       })
      output$plot0 <- renderPlot({
        morpion0()
        update()
      })
      output$click <- renderPrint({
        input$click
      })
    },
    ui=pageWithSidebar(
      headerPanel("Tic-tac-toe"), 
      sidebarPanel(
        verbatimTextOutput("click")
      ),
      mainPanel(
        plotOutput("plot0", clickId="click")
      )
    )
  )
)
